name: Manhattan Village
description: Manhattan Village is an upscale open-air shopping center in the heart of Manhattan Beach, featuring premier retailers, dining destinations, and a vibrant community atmosphere. With Macy's as its anchor store and a carefully curated mix of fashion, lifestyle, and specialty shops, this center serves the affluent beach communities of the South Bay. The center combines California coastal style with sophisticated shopping in a pedestrian-friendly outdoor setting.
demographics: Serves affluent Manhattan Beach and South Bay communities with high household incomes, strong education levels, and a lifestyle-oriented demographic focused on quality and beach culture.
summary: Manhattan Village is an upscale open-air lifestyle center in Manhattan Beach offering premier shopping, dining, and entertainment for the South Bay's coastal communities.
